result.rationale: Boingo is one continuing U.S. platform acquired on 2021-06-02 by Digital Colony Partners II, now DigitalBridge Partners II. Current Boingo and DigitalBridge pages still show DigitalBridge ownership. No direct InfraBridge equity, duplicate, successor or signed/closed Boingo exit was found.

identityResolution.result: ONE_CANONICAL_COMPANY; NO DUPLICATE, SUCCESSOR OR REBRAND
identityResolution.boundary: Venues, customers, contracts and DAS/Wi-Fi/network deployments remain beneath Boingo, not separate PortCos.

owners.organization: White Sands Parent, Inc. (last disclosed parent)
owners.fund: DigitalBridge Partners II, L.P. (formerly Digital Colony Partners II, L.P.)
owners.vehicle: White Sands Bidco, Inc. (merger sub; merged into Boingo)

ownershipResolution.control: Boingo survived as White Sands Parent's wholly owned subsidiary; DigitalBridge remains the supported controlling manager. No other direct infrastructure owner is disclosed.
ownershipResolution.infraBridge: EXCLUDED: Boingo was acquired by DBP II in 2021; InfraBridge became a separate DigitalBridge unit in 2023, does not list Boingo and has no disclosed Boingo equity transaction.

operatingResolution.subsector: Neutral-host DAS, Wi-Fi, private networks, small cells, fiber, towers and public-safety/ERCES
operatingResolution.business: Designs, builds and manages converged public and private wireless networks worldwide.
operatingResolution.endMarkets: Airports/transit, sports venues, military/federal, healthcare, commercial real estate, hospitality and multifamily.
operatingResolution.scale: 2026-06-16: 130+ airports/transport hubs, 70+ sports/entertainment venues and 100+ U.S. military bases.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: Merger agreement signed 2021-02-26 among Boingo, White Sands Parent and White Sands Bidco; announced 2021-03-01; closed 2021-06-02. Public shares received $14 cash each; value was about $854 million including about $199 million net debt.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterSearch: Infralogic reported an unclear-stage possible sale process on 2024-11-11. No buyer, definitive agreement, recapitalization, transfer, merger, rebrand or close was found through 2026-08-19.
acquisitionExitCheck.managerLevelContext: SoftBank's acquisition of DigitalBridge remained pending on 2026-08-04; it is not a direct Boingo transfer and does not change Boingo's owner period.

milestones.event: Merger closed; Boingo became private and left Nasdaq.
